blocks.text: Yeh Unit 3 (Integration) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Evaluate (i) \(\int \sin^{2}x\cos^{2}x\,dx\) (ii) \(\int (\tan x + \cot x)^{2}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(Yeh integrals maloom karein: (i) \(\int \sin^{2}x\cos^{2}x\,dx\) (ii) \(\int (\tan x + \cot x)^{2}\,dx\).)
blocks.explanation: Pehle identities se squares khatam karein, phir har term integrate karein.

book_ref.quote: Examples 5 to 11 show the main ideas for trigonometric integrals

blocks.prompt:
2 Evaluate \(\int \frac{x^{3}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 4}}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \frac{x^{3}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 4}}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(u = x^{2} + 4\) lein; aik \(x\), \(dx\) ke saath jata hai aur baqi \(x^{2}\) ko \(u\) mein likhein.

book_ref.quote: Rewrite the whole integral in \(u\)

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove that \(\int \frac{dx}{x^{2} - a^{2}} = \frac{1}{2a}\ln\left|\frac{x - a}{x + a}\right| + c\) (\(a > 0\)). Hence evaluate \(\int \frac{dx}{4x^{2} - 9}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\int \frac{dx}{x^{2} - a^{2}} = \frac{1}{2a}\ln\left|\frac{x - a}{x + a}\right| + c\) (\(a > 0\)). Phir \(\int \frac{dx}{4x^{2} - 9}\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(1 = \frac{(x + a) - (x - a)}{2a}\) likh kar fraction ko do aasan fractions mein todein.

book_ref.quote: The key trick: the numerator 1 is written as

blocks.prompt:
4 Using the substitution \(x = a\tan\theta\), prove that \(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{a^{2} + x^{2}}} = \ln\left|x + \sqrt{a^{2} + x^{2}}\right| + c\), where \(a > 0\). (5 marks)
(\(x = a\tan\theta\) se saabit karein ke \(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{a^{2} + x^{2}}} = \ln\left|x + \sqrt{a^{2} + x^{2}}\right| + c\), \(a > 0\).)
blocks.explanation: Root mein constant plus variable: \(x = a\tan\theta\) se root \(a\sec\theta\) ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In (iii) and (iv) a constant \(-\ln a\) appears

steps: \(-\ln a\) ko constant mein shamil karein: \(c = c_{1} - \ln a\)

blocks.prompt:
5 Evaluate \(\int \frac{x^{2}}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \frac{x^{2}}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 2\sin\theta\) rakhein; phir \(\sin^{2}\theta = \frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}\) aur right triangle se wapas \(x\).

book_ref.quote: Case 1: Integrals involving

6 Evaluate \(\int \frac{dx}{x^{2}\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\), \(0 < x < 3\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \frac{dx}{x^{2}\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\), \(0 < x < 3\), maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 3\sin\theta\) rakhein; integrand \(\csc^{2}\theta\) ka multiple ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A right triangle helps: from

blocks.prompt:
7 Prove that \(\int \sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}}\,dx = \frac{x}{2}\sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}} + \frac{a^{2}}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a} + c\) (\(a > 0\)). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\int \sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}}\,dx = \frac{x}{2}\sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}} + \frac{a^{2}}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a} + c\) (\(a > 0\)).)
blocks.explanation: Root \(\times 1\) likh kar by parts, \(x^{2} = a^{2} - (a^{2} - x^{2})\) istemal karein aur \(I\) ke liye hal karein.

book_ref.quote: write the root \(\times\) 1, integrate by parts

blocks.prompt:
8 Evaluate \(\int e^{2x}\sin 3x\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int e^{2x}\sin 3x\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa by parts, dono dafa trigonometric function pehla; integral wapas aata hai, phir \(I\) ke liye hal karein.

book_ref.quote: In the next example the integral comes back after integrating by parts twice.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Jab integral by parts ke baad dobara wahi \(I\) aa jaye to ghabrayein nahin: usay aam equation (muadla) ki tarah aik taraf le jayein. Dono rounds mein pehla function wahi rakhein (yahan \(\sin\)/\(\cos\)); warna kaam ulat jata hai aur \(I = I\) milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Evaluate \(\int x^{2}\cos x\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int x^{2}\cos x\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2}\) pehla function; har round mein power aik kam, do rounds kafi.

book_ref.quote: Integration by parts is a technique for simplifying integrals of the form

blocks.prompt:
10 Evaluate \(\int \sqrt{x^{2} + 4x + 8}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \sqrt{x^{2} + 4x + 8}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Square mukammal karein; plus sign hai, is liye Special Integral \(\int \sqrt{u^{2} + k^{2}}\,du\).

book_ref.quote: A plus sign between the square and the constant inside the root

blocks.prompt:
11 Evaluate \(\int \frac{2x^{2} + x + 3}{(x + 1)(x^{2} + 1)}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \frac{2x^{2} + x + 3}{(x + 1)(x^{2} + 1)}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Case-III: \(x + 1\) par constant aur irreducible \(x^{2} + 1\) par linear numerator.

book_ref.quote: Case-III: Linear and non repeated irreducible quadratic factors.

blocks.prompt:
12 Evaluate \(\int \frac{x^{2} + 2}{(x - 1)^{2}(x + 2)}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \frac{x^{2} + 2}{(x - 1)^{2}(x + 2)}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Case-II: repeated factor \((x - 1)^{2}\) ke liye do fractions.

book_ref.quote: Repeated \((x - a)^k\): \(k\) fractions with powers

blocks.prompt:
13 Evaluate \(\int \frac{dx}{x(x^{2} + 1)^{2}}\). (5 marks)
(\(\int \frac{dx}{x(x^{2} + 1)^{2}}\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Case-IV: \(x\) ke liye aik fraction aur \(x^{2} + 1\) ki har power ke liye linear numerator wala fraction.

book_ref.quote: Case-IV: Linear and repeated irreducible quadratic factors.

blocks.prompt:
14 Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\cos x}{(1 + \sin x)(2 + \sin x)}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\cos x}{(1 + \sin x)(2 + \sin x)}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(u = \sin x\) rakhein aur limits badlein; phir partial fractions.

book_ref.quote: Use it when the integrand contains some function \(g(x)\) together with its derivative

blocks.prompt:
15 Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}e^{x}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}e^{x}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa by parts, \(x^{2}\) pehla function; har mukammal hissa limits par evaluate karein.

book_ref.quote: This is the integration by parts rule of 3.4, word for word

blocks.prompt:
16 Prove that \(\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{a}^{b} f(a + b - x)\,dx\). Hence show that \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin x - \cos x}{1 + \sin x\cos x}\,dx = 0\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{a}^{b} f(a + b - x)\,dx\). Phir dikhayein ke \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin x - \cos x}{1 + \sin x\cos x}\,dx = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x = a + b - t\) rakhein, Property II aur I lagayein; phir \([0, \frac{\pi}{2}]\) par \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) badal jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Why Property-IV is true: put

steps: \(x = a + b - t\): \(dx = -dt\); limits \(b\) aur \(a\) ho jate hain
\(\int_{b}^{a} f(a + b - t)(-dt) = \int_{a}^{b} f(a + b - t)\,dt\) (Property-II)
\(I\) mein \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2} - x\): \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) aapas mein badal jate hain
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; aur \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin x - \cos x}{1 + \sin x\cos x}\,dx = 0\)

blocks.prompt:
17 Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\sin x}{1 + \cos^{2}x}\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\sin x}{1 + \cos^{2}x}\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Property-IV, \(x \to \pi - x\): \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos^{2}x\) wahi rehte hain magar \(x\) ban jata hai \(\pi - x\); dono jama karne se \(x\) khatam.

book_ref.quote: if it becomes a partner integral, add the two

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan \(\frac{x\sin x}{1 + \cos^{2}x}\) ka seedha antiderivative mushkil hai. Property-IV ka faida yeh hai ke \(x\) aur \(\pi - x\) wale do integrals jama karne se \(x\) ghayab ho jata hai aur sirf aasan integral bachta hai.

blocks.prompt:
18 Evaluate \(\int_{-1}^{2} |x^{2} - x|\,dx\). (5 marks)
(\(\int_{-1}^{2} |x^{2} - x|\,dx\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x(x - 1)\) ka sign kahan badalta hai, wahan interval todein (Property-III) aur har hisse mein bars hata dein.

book_ref.quote: contains absolute values (Example 50)

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the area of the region bounded by the curve \(y = x^{3} - 4x\) and the \(x\)-axis. (5 marks)
(Curve \(y = x^{3} - 4x\) aur \(x\)-axis se ghire region ka area maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Roots nikaalein, har hissa alag integrate karein aur absolute values jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Integrate separately on each piece between the roots.

steps: Area \(= 4 + |-4|\) (seedha \(-2\) se \(2\) tak integrate karne se 0 aata)

blocks.prompt:
20 Find the area of the region bounded by the parabolas \(y = x^{2}\) and \(y = 4x - x^{2}\). (5 marks)
(Parabolas \(y = x^{2}\) aur \(y = 4x - x^{2}\) se ghire region ka area maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Milne ke points limits dete hain; aik point par dekhein kaun upar hai; (upar \(-\) neeche) integrate karein.

book_ref.quote: Area between two curves. If

blocks.prompt:
21 The demand function is \(p = 40 - x^{2}\) and the supply function is \(p = 3x^{2} + 4\). Find the equilibrium point, the consumer surplus and the producer surplus. (5 marks)
(Demand \(p = 40 - x^{2}\) aur supply \(p = 3x^{2} + 4\) hai. Equilibrium point, consumer surplus aur producer surplus maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(D(x) = S(x)\) se \(x_e\) (ghair manfi root), phir CS aur PS ke formulas.

book_ref.quote: The point where the demand and supply curves intersect is called the market equilibrium.

blocks.prompt:
22 The demand function is \(p = 60 - 3x\) and the market price is \(p_e = 30\). Find the consumer surplus (i) by integrating with respect to \(x\) (ii) by integrating with respect to \(p\). (5 marks)
(Demand \(p = 60 - 3x\), market price \(p_e = 30\). Consumer surplus (i) \(x\) ke lihaz se (ii) \(p\) ke lihaz se integrate kar ke maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) se: limits \(0\) se \(x_e\). \(p\) se: limits \(p_e\) se \(p_{\max} = D(0)\), integrand \(x_d(p)\).

book_ref.quote: Both methods must give the same answer; use the second as a check.

blocks.prompt:
23 By revolving the line \(y = \frac{r}{h}x\), \(0 \le x \le h\), about the \(x\)-axis, show that the volume of a right circular cone of radius \(r\) and height \(h\) is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2}h\). Hence find the volume when \(r = 3\) cm, \(h = 4\) cm. (5 marks)
(Line \(y = \frac{r}{h}x\), \(0 \le x \le h\), ko \(x\)-axis ke gird ghuma kar dikhayein ke radius \(r\), height \(h\) wali cone ka volume \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2}h\) hai. Phir \(r = 3\) cm, \(h = 4\) cm ke liye volume.)
blocks.explanation: Origin se guzarti line \(x = h\) par height \(r\) tak pohanchti hai; disk method lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Let \(f\) be continuous and non-negative on \([a, b]\)

steps: \(x = h\) par \(y = r\): cone ka radius \(r\), height \(h\)

blocks.prompt:
24 A solid has a circular base of radius 3. Parallel cross-sections perpendicular to the base are squares. Find the volume of the solid. (5 marks)
(Aik solid ka base radius 3 ka circle hai. Base ke perpendicular mutawazi cross-sections squares hain. Solid ka volume maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Base \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\); \(x\) par square chord par khara hai, side \(2y\).

book_ref.quote: Plan: (1) draw the base, (2) express the size of one slice

steps: Base \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\); chord ki lambai \(2\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}\)
Square ka area \(A(x) = 4(9 - x^{2})\) (\(y\) ko base ki equation se hataein)

blocks.prompt:
25 Find the moment of inertia of a uniform rod of length \(2a\) and mass \(M\) about a line through its middle and perpendicular to the rod, and its radius of gyration. Hence find \(I\) for a rod of length 3 m and mass 4 kg. (5 marks)
(\(2a\) lambi, mass \(M\) ki uniform rod ka us ke darmiyan se guzarne wali perpendicular line ke gird moment of inertia aur radius of gyration maloom karein. Phir 3 m lambi, 4 kg ki rod ke liye \(I\).)
blocks.explanation: Rod ko darmiyan se \(x\) faaslay par chhote hisson \(\delta x\) mein kaatein; \(x^{2}dm\) ko \(-a\) se \(a\) tak integrate karein.

book_ref.quote: The moment of inertia of a rigid body having continuous matter is:

blocks.final_answer: \(I = \frac{1}{3}Ma^{2}\), \(R = \frac{a}{\sqrt{3}}\); di gayi rod ke liye \(I = 3\) kg m\(^{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
26 A particle moves along a straight line with acceleration \(a(t) = 2t - 6\) m/s\(^{2}\) and initial velocity \(v(0) = 5\) m/s. Find (i) \(v(t)\) (ii) the displacement during \(0 \le t \le 6\) (iii) the distance travelled during \(0 \le t \le 6\). (5 marks)
(Particle ka acceleration \(a(t) = 2t - 6\) m/s\(^{2}\) aur \(v(0) = 5\) m/s hai. (i) \(v(t)\) (ii) \(0 \le t \le 6\) mein displacement (iii) usi waqt mein kul faasla maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a\) ko integrate kar ke \(v(0)\) se constant; displacement \(\int v\,dt\); faaslay ke liye \(v\) ke zeros par todein.

book_ref.quote: find where \(v = 0\), split the interval, and take \(-v\) where \(v < 0\)

blocks.prompt:
27 Answer both parts. (i) The temperature in a room \(t\) hours after 8 a.m. is \(T(t) = 20 + 4t - \frac{t^{2}}{2}\) \(^{\circ}\)C. Find the average temperature from \(t = 0\) to \(t = 6\). (ii) Find \(k\) if the average value of \(f(x) = kx^{2}\) on \([0, 3]\) is 12. (5 marks)
(Dono hisson ke jawab dein. (i) Subah 8 baje ke \(t\) ghante baad kamre ka temperature \(T(t) = 20 + 4t - \frac{t^{2}}{2}\) \(^{\circ}\)C hai. \(t = 0\) se \(t = 6\) tak average temperature. (ii) Agar \([0, 3]\) par \(f(x) = kx^{2}\) ki average value 12 ho to \(k\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hisson mein \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b - a}\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx\); (ii) mein \(k\) ki equation banti hai.

book_ref.quote: If \(f\) is continuous on \([a, b]\), then its average value on \([a, b]\)

blocks.prompt:
28 For the model \(C(t) = C_{0}e^{-kt}\) (\(k > 0\)), show that \(\int_{0}^{T} C(t)\,dt = \frac{C_{0}}{k}(1 - e^{-kT})\) and \(\int_{0}^{\infty} C(t)\,dt = \frac{C_{0}}{k}\). Hence, for \(C(t) = 15e^{-0.3t}\) mg/L, find the AUC over the first 5 hours and the total AUC. (5 marks)
(Model \(C(t) = C_{0}e^{-kt}\) (\(k > 0\)) ke liye dikhayein ke \(\int_{0}^{T} C(t)\,dt = \frac{C_{0}}{k}(1 - e^{-kT})\) aur \(\int_{0}^{\infty} C(t)\,dt = \frac{C_{0}}{k}\). Phir \(C(t) = 15e^{-0.3t}\) mg/L ke liye pehle 5 ghanton ka AUC aur kul AUC.)
blocks.explanation: \(e^{-kt}\) integrate karein (\(-k\) se taqseem); la-mehdood limit ke liye \(b\) tak integrate kar ke \(b \to \infty\).

book_ref.quote: The second integral has an infinite upper limit (an improper integral)

steps: Pehle 5 ghante: \(50(1 - e^{-1.5}) \approx 38.84\); kul AUC \(= 50\) mg hr/L
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; \(\text{AUC}_{0\to 5} \approx 38.84\) mg hr/L, \(\text{AUC}_{0\to\infty} = 50\) mg hr/L
